recognize_zh: 肌肉切片低倍下，藍色的淋巴細胞浸潤沿肌束之間的肌內膜蔓延，呈網狀包圍單一肌纖維；CD20 與 CD10 以相同網狀分布強陽性，高倍 CD10 下為大型淋巴球，神經切片可見神經外膜血管旁淋巴細胞聚集，符合 DLBCL 侵犯肌肉與神經。
features: Skeletal muscle (A): dense lymphoid infiltrate dissecting between individual muscle fibers in an interstitial, lace-like pattern
CD20 (B) and CD10 (C): strong membranous staining of the same infiltrate outlining the muscle fibers
CD10 high power (E): sheets of large lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and membranous positivity surrounding atrophic/unstained myofibers
Sural nerve (D): nerve fascicles with an adjacent perivascular/epineurial aggregate of lymphoid cells
Preserved muscle fiber outlines without obvious myonecrosis at this magnification
describe_en: Biopsy of the gastrocnemius muscle shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of lymphoid cells percolating between individual skeletal muscle fibers in a reticular pattern. At high power the infiltrate consists of large lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei that are strongly positive for CD20 and CD10. The sural nerve biopsy shows an epineurial, perivascular aggregate of similar lymphoid cells adjacent to nerve fascicles. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (germinal center B-cell phenotype by CD10) involving skeletal muscle and peripheral nerve (neurolymphomatosis).

ddx.vs: Myositis shows small T-cells (CD8+) invading non-necrotic fibers with myofiber degeneration, not sheets of large CD20+/CD10+ B-cells.
Vasculitis shows transmural mixed inflammation with fibrinoid necrosis of vessel walls rather than a monotonous large B-cell aggregate.
Burkitt lymphoma is also CD10+ but has medium-sized monotonous cells, starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 ~100% and MYC rearrangement without BCL2.
